riskFollowups.text: The Alpha data review found mixed regular/playoff rows and field-goal rates using the wrong denominator. The linked fixes will separate the phases and check team and league totals against the source before the new comparisons are released.

The new comparisons will keep all play types visible with possession counts and a sample cutoff. Low-count rows will be flagged and excluded from the Top 3. Tests cover missing categories and cases with no supported positive weak spot.

Opponent weak spots will show observed allowed PPP. The final outcome view will show overlapping rates separately, and the two-team profile view will clearly use whole-season data. None of these views will claim future accuracy or direct-game results.
The phase-mixing defect is linked to a separate fix. The planned trend view will compare the same regular-season scope across seasons and show missing coverage as gaps.
Each new view will bind its chart and table to the same successful filter result. The test plan covers changed filters, failed requests and retries.

The six new baseline use cases are split across the releases: two for Alpha, two for Beta and two for Final. Alpha work is planned for October 29, ahead of the October 30 submission deadline. Existing teammate tasks and release dates are unchanged.

preserved: Existing issue ownership, risk ratings, risk statuses, descriptions, historical comments and links are preserved. Only the baseline Feature was reopened to track its new authorized scope. No worklogs were created or edited.

commentReceipts.body:
Before the fix, this check failed. The source audit found 531 combined possessions and PPP 0.9417363465. The regression fixture also returned 160 possessions instead of 110 and accepted a missing SEASON_ID.

The fix is tracked in [SCRUM-701](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-701). The original output is saved in baseline-regressions-before.txt; the case needs a recorded retest before it can pass.

Before the fix, this check failed. The audit found FG% 46.1108% and eFG% 48.7547% from possession weighting. The fixtures also showed rounded PPP replacing exact counts and an incorrect league FG denominator.

The fix is tracked in [SCRUM-702](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-702). The original output is saved in baseline-regressions-before.txt; the case needs a recorded retest before it can pass.

Before the fix, this check failed. The regression expected a duplicate-row error, but the current aggregation accepted the duplicate.

The fix is tracked in [SCRUM-701](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-701). The original output is saved in baseline-regressions-before.txt; the case needs a recorded retest before it can pass.

Before the fix, this check failed. The audit reproduced predicted PPP falling from 1.10 to 1.04 when allowed PPP rose from 0.9 to 1.1.

The fix is tracked in [SCRUM-703](https://basketball-strategy.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-703). The original output is saved in baseline-regressions-before.txt; the case needs a recorded retest before it can pass.

Added six new baseline use cases: usage and efficiency (SCRUM-695) and opponent weak spots (SCRUM-696) for Alpha; league comparison (SCRUM-697) and season trends (SCRUM-698) for Beta; two-team profiles (SCRUM-699) and possession outcome rates (SCRUM-700) for Final. Each has a VP use-case reference, development tasks and a test suite. Alpha is planned for October 29, ahead of the October 30 submission deadline; the four later stories remain To Do.
